config(bytes32).details: A wat's config is composed of its bar security parameter and set of      lifted validators encoded as bloom.Reverts if:      - `wat` is zero      - `wat` not supported

params.wat: The wat to return its config.

returns._1: The wat's set of lifted validators encoded as bloom.

params.validatorId: The id of the validator to drop.

params.validatorIds: The ids of the validators to drop.

gracePeriod().details: The grace period is the time period after a wat's config update      during which both, the new and previous, wat's configs are valid.      This period is necessary to give ample time for non-finalized txs      and Chronicle Protocol low-latency API providers to update to the      new config.Note that offboarded wats do not have a grace period!

lift(address).details: Only callable by auth'ed address.Reverts if:      - `validator` is zero address

lift(address[]).details: Only callable by auth'ed address.Reverts if:      - any validator in `validators` is zero address

setConfig(bytes32,uint8,uint256).details: A wat's config is composed of its bar security parameter and set of      lifted validators encoded as bloom.Note that this function is used to add initial support for a new      wat, updating a wat's config, and removing support for a wat.      A wat's support is removed via setting its bar and bloom parameters      to zero.Only callable by auth'ed address.Reverts if:      - exclusively `bar` or `bloom` zero

params.bar: The bar to update wat `wat`'s config to.
params.bloom: The set of lifted validators encoded as bloom to update              wat `wat`'s config to.
params.wat: The wat to update its config.

stalenessThreshold().details: The staleness threshold is the time after which a validator      message's age will be deemed invalid.

BarIsZero().notice: Thrown if wat message's bar is zero.

ConfigInvalid().notice: Thrown if wat message's config invalid.

DoubleSigningAttempted().notice: Thrown if at least two validator messages from the same         validator.

FutureMessage().notice: Thrown if any validator message from the future.

MessagesNotSorted().notice: Thrown if validator messages not in ascending order based on         their value.

NotAValidator().notice: Thrown if any validator message signed by non-validator address.

NotAuthorized(address).notice: Thrown by protected function if caller not auth'ed.

NotEntrypoint().notice: Thrown if message verification requested by a different address         than the entrypoint.

SchemeMismatch().notice: Thrown if wat message's scheme does not match verifier's scheme.

SignerIsZeroAddress().notice: Thrown if any validator message signed by the zero address.

StaleMessage().notice: Thrown if any validator message stale.

VersionMismatch().notice: Thrown if wat message's version does not match verifier's         version.

WatIsZero().notice: Thrown if wat message's wat is zero.

WatNotSupported().notice: Thrown if wat message's wat not supported.

ZeroBar().notice: Thrown if wat message's bar is zero.

AuthGranted(address,address).notice: Emitted when auth granted to address.

AuthRenounced(address,address).notice: Emitted when auth renounced from address.

ConfigUpdated(address,bytes32,uint8,uint.notice: Emitted when a wat's config updated.

authed().notice: Returns full list of addresses granted auth.

drop(uint8).notice: Drops validator with id `validatorId` from Chronicle Protocol's         global low-latency validator set.

drop(uint8[]).notice: Drops list of validators with ids `validatorIds` from Chronicle         Protocol's global low-latency validator set.

entrypoint().notice: The low-latency entrypoint contract from which the verifier         accepts verify requests.

gracePeriod().notice: Returns the grace period in seconds.

lift(address).notice: Lifts validator `validator` to Chronicle Protocol's global         low-latency validator set.

lift(address[]).notice: Lifts list of validators `validators` to Chronicle Protocol's         global low-latency validator set.

scheme().notice: The low-latency message verification scheme the verifier         supports.

stalenessThreshold().notice: Returns the staleness threshold in seconds.

validators().notice: Returns the global set of Chronicle Protocol validators lifted         for low-latency oracles.

validators(address).notice: Returns whether validator `validator_` is part of Chronicle         Protocol's global set of validators lifted for low-latency         oracles.

validators(bytes32).notice: Returns the set of lifted validators for wat `wat`.

validators(bytes32,address).notice: Returns whether validator `validator` is lifted for wat `wat`.

version().notice: The low-latency message version the verifier supports.
